products.name: Team Rocket Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs of the Unlimited print. TCGplayer lists the Unlimited box (209437) at $36,000 (its low and mid are both $36,000, no market price), which is the price here, against $11,718.72 for 36 packs at the pack's market price.

products.name: Theme Deck "Devastation"
products.note: A 60-card Team Rocket theme deck, featuring Dark Weezing (Team Rocket 14); silver holographic Meowth coin. Not simulated: coin and markers. List: Bulbapedia deck page and PokeBeach's Team Rocket theme-deck page (they differ by a card in places).

products.name: Theme Deck "Trouble"
products.note: A 60-card Team Rocket theme deck, featuring Dark Arbok (Team Rocket 2); silver holographic Meowth coin. Not simulated: coin and markers. List: Bulbapedia deck page and PokeBeach's Team Rocket theme-deck page (they differ by a card in places).
